meaning:
δια-βάλλω
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:8, Da TH 3:8; 6:24 (25) (אֲכַל קְרַץ), 2Ma.3:11, 4Ma.4:1 * ;]
1. to throw across.
2. To slander, defame, accuse falsely or maliciously: Luk.16:1 (Cremer, 120).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
